notes.title: 📢 Shotball Update V.1.4 is Live! 🚀
notes.content: [p]Shotball Update 1.4[/p][p]Hey players, we’ve got a fresh update rolling out with some big quality-of-life improvements: [/p][p][/p][p][b]New Animations[/b] – Movement and actions now look smoother with remade transitions. notes.title: 📢 Shotball Update V.1.3 is Live! 🚀
notes.content:
📢 Shotball Update V.1.3 is Live! 🚀

Dear players,

We’re excited to introduce Update V.1.3, bringing major gameplay improvements, a new ranked mode, and more competitive action

🏆 Ranked Mode is Here!

    The Ranked Mode has officially launched! Test your skills and climb the ranks.

⚡ Matchmaking Improvements:

    Faster matchmaking for a smoother and quicker experience.

🎭 Movement Animation Enhancements:

    Improved movement animations for a more fluid and responsive feel.

🛒 Store Update & New Bundle Release:

    A fresh new bundle is now available—check it out in the store!

🎯 Enhanced Enemy Visibility:

    Opponents now appear with a red outline for easier identification.
    Enemy team equipment is now highlighted in red, making it easier to locate, disable, or destroy.

⚖️ Gameplay Balancing & Adjustments:

    Various in-game elements have been fine-tuned for better balance.
    Increased knockdown protection time, giving you a chance to recover after being taken down.

✨ And much more!

💬 We’re Always Listening:
If you have any feedback or encounter issues, let us know! The Shotball team is committed to continuous improvements.

🚀 Update now and jump into the action!!
🔥 See you in the arena! 🎮

notes.title: 📢 Shotball Update V.1.2 is Live! 🚀
notes.content:
Dear players,

We’re thrilled to announce the release of Update V.1.2, packed with exciting gameplay improvements, matchmaking enhancements, and a better store experience to elevate your gameplay!

🎮 Gameplay Improvements:

    🔥 Ultimate Ability Fix: Resolved an issue where the ultimate ability couldn’t be used in certain situations.
    🎉 Enhanced Celebrations & Emotes: Enjoy smoother and more dynamic celebrations and special emotes.
    💥 Improved Visual Effects: Upgraded visual effects for the special energy ball for a more immersive experience.
    🎯 Friendly Fire Indicator: A new indicator now shows if a teammate accidentally hits you.

🌐 Matchmaking & Search Enhancements:

    📊 Region Session Count Indicator: You can now see the number of active sessions in each region to help you choose the best one.
    ⏱️ Minimum Player Limit for Matches: Matches will now start with a minimum player count, allowing players to join mid-game if needed.
    🌍 Automatic Region Switching: If matchmaking takes longer than 8 minutes, the system will automatically switch to a more active region. If you cancel the search, it will revert to your original region.

🛒 Store Experience Improvements:

    🏷️ Redeem Code Feature: Players can now redeem special codes for exclusive rewards.
    🤝 Support Code Feature: Support your favorite Shotball content creators with the new support code option.
    ⚡ Shotball Box Shortcut: A new shortcut has been added for quick and easy Shotball Box purchases.

💬 We’re Always Listening:
If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to reach out. The Shotball team is dedicated to providing you with the best gaming experience possible!

✨ Update your game now and enjoy the latest Shotball experience!

🔥 Get ready for the challenge see you in the arena! 🎮

notes.title: 📢 SHOTBALL Update HOTFIX V.1.1 is Live! 🚀
notes.content:
📢 Shotball Update V.1 is Live! 🚀

Dear players,

We’re excited to share that we’ve addressed key technical issues from the previous version to improve your gaming experience:

🔧 Server Stability and Availability Fixed:

Server stability issues have been resolved.
If you encounter long matchmaking times, it could mean there aren’t enough players in your region. For a smoother experience, we recommend switching to more active regions like Bahrain or Frankfurt.

🛠️ Loading Screen Issue Resolved:

    The problem causing the loading screen to freeze after matches has been fixed.

🤝 Improved Invite System (INV):

    We have enhanced the invite system for a smoother and faster experience when inviting friends to your matches.

💬 We’re Listening:
If you face any other issues, don’t hesitate to let us know! The Shotball team apologizes for any technical issues you may have faced and is committed to resolving them as quickly as possible.

✨ Update your game now and enjoy an enhanced Shotball experience!

🔥 Let’s hit the field see you in the arena! 🎮
